summary: Athena Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on October 20, 2026, announcing the immediate appointment of Jordan Quinn, P.Geo., as Vice President of Exploration, succeeding Benjamin Kuzmich, who resigned the role but remains as a consulting Lead Technical Advisor. No financial terms, stake, price, premium or advisor were disclosed; the release is routine transition rather than a forced departure. Quinn, a former Newmont and Barrick geologist, was already Lead Technical Advisor and helped execute the Laird Lake maiden drill program and Scooby Zone discovery. What to watch: drill results at Laird and continuity of technical strategy; no risk-arb angle.
